hook: One convincing email. Twenty three inboxes. It only takes one click.
stat: About sixty percent of confirmed breaches involve a human action, like clicking a link.
intro: Here is how Mova iO handles a phishing report, from first click to clean inboxes.
s1: It starts with a careful employee. Kavya in finance gets an invoice email from a domain that looks almost right, and reports it from Outlook.
s2: In Microsoft Defender, Mova iO's triage agent picks up the report. The domain was registered two days ago, the link leads to a fake sign-in page, and the same message reached twenty three people. Verdict: malicious.
s3: In Threat Explorer, it finds every copy of the email and sees that two people clicked the link.
s4: Removing mail from twenty three inboxes is a big action, so the S O C lead approves it in Teams first.
s5: Defender soft-deletes every copy, blocks the sender and the U R L, and the agent checks the two people who clicked. No sign-ins from new places, but their sessions are reset as a precaution.
s6: Kavya gets a thank-you and a plain explanation, and the security incident in ServiceNow closes with the full evidence.
close: One report from one person. Every copy gone in minutes. The two people who clicked, protected.
tag: Phishing, contained by Mova iO agents. With people in control.
end: Movate. Your applied A I partner.
